prompt: We're switching our background job queue from BullMQ (Redis-backed) to Temporal (durable workflow engine). The main reasons: BullMQ jobs were getting lost during Redis failovers, and we need long-running workflows that can pause and resume. Downside is Temporal requires running a separate worker process and has more ops overhead. Write an ADR for this decision.
assertions: ADR has all required sections: Status, Context, Decision, Rationale, Consequences
Context mentions the BullMQ/Redis failover problem specifically
Rationale explains why Temporal was chosen over alternatives
Consequences explicitly mentions the separate worker process and ops overhead
AI Context section instructs an agent not to suggest reverting to BullMQ without reading the failover incident
